extDescription.message: Translate selected text via right-click, shortcut or popup. On-device by default, or use your own OpenAI/DeepL key.

error_AUTH.message: The API key was rejected. Check that it is correct and still valid.

error_QUOTA.message: The usage limit or rate limit of your API plan was reached. Wait a moment or check your plan.

error_NETWORK.message: Could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.

error_TOO_LONG.message: The text is too long for this engine. Select a shorter passage.

error_UNSUPPORTED_LANG.message: This language pair is not supported by the selected engine.

error_NO_KEY.message: No API key is registered for the selected engine.

error_PERMISSION_MISSING.message: Permission to contact this provider has not been granted. Save the key again in Settings.

error_BUILTIN_UNAVAILABLE.message: On-device translation is not available in this browser (requires desktop Chrome 138 or later). You can register your own API key instead.

error_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_REQUIRED.message: The on-device translation model needs to be downloaded first. Click the button to download it and continue.

error_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE.message: The on-device model could not be prepared on this device (e.g. not enough storage).

error_DETECTION_FAILED.message: Could not detect the language of the text. Set the source language in Settings.

error_NO_SELECTION.message: Select some text on the page first.

error_UNKNOWN.message: Translation failed due to an unexpected error.

hudFallbackNotice.message: $ARG1$ failed, so this was translated on-device instead (reason: $ARG2$).

hudAiFailedAlso.message: $ARG1$ failed (reason: $ARG2$), and on-device translation could not be used either.

hudToneNotSupported.message: $ARG1$ does not support this tone, so a standard translation is shown.

toneHintFree.message: Tones are available with AI engines (your own key).

sourcePlaceholder.message: Select text on the page, or type here…

resultPlaceholder.message: Selected text on the page is picked up automatically.

donatePromptLine.message: If QuickLens has been useful, your support would be appreciated.

engineDesc.message: On-device translation works without a key. With your own key, text is sent to that AI provider.

toneDesc.message: Tones apply to OpenAI. DeepL supports Natural and Formal. On-device translation always uses Natural.

keysDesc.message: When you save a key, Chrome asks for permission to contact that provider. Removing a key also removes the permission.

keyLabel_deepl.message: DeepL API key (Free keys end with :fx)

keyRemoved.message: Removed. Permission for this provider was also removed.

keyPermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so the key was not saved.

labelAutoTranslatePopup.message: Translate selected text automatically when the popup opens

shortcutHowToChange.message: To change it, open Chrome's extension shortcut settings.

privacyOnDevice.message: On-device translation runs inside Chrome on this device. The text is not sent anywhere for translation.

privacyByok.message: If you choose OpenAI or DeepL, the selected text is sent directly from your browser to that provider, using your own key, and is handled under that provider's policy.

privacyKeys.message: Keys are stored only on this device and are not sent to the developer's server (the developer does not run any server).

privacyNoServer.message: Settings sync through your Chrome account. The translation count used for the support message stays on this device. No analytics are collected.

donateDesc.message: QuickLens is free with every feature available to everyone. If you find it useful, you can support its development.

resetConfirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults? (API keys are kept.)

onboardingLead.message: Translate any text you select on a web page.

howContextMenuBody.message: Select text, right-click, and choose "Translate with QuickLens".

howPopupBody.message: Click the QuickLens icon in the toolbar. Selected text is filled in, or type your own.

engineFreeExplain.message: Default. Uses Chrome's built-in translation model on this device. Free, no key, and the text stays on your device. The model is downloaded once per language pair.

engineAiExplain.message: Optional. Register your own OpenAI or DeepL key in Settings to use tones like Formal or Summary. The text is then sent to that provider.

prepareDone.message: Ready. On-device translation can be used.
